correctness.rationale: The full finite domain is reduced without loss to codes containing 00000 via xor translation. The verifier maintains the exact ordinary pair-sum set including repeated pairs, exhausts every normalized subset once, proves maximum size 12, enumerates 72 normalized maxima and 192 labeled maxima, and checks that one full Hamming-isometry orbit equals the entire census. Direct recomputation gives stabilizer order 20 and the claimed balance, antipodal, and distance invariants.
